name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should adopt a 3px solid focus ring with a 2px outer offset, colored #007AFF, as it provides a clear visual indication of focus for keyboard users and aligns with Apple's accessibility guidelines. This decision prioritizes usability over design minimalism, which is a trade-off I'm accepting to ensure our product is accessible to everyone. By using a thicker focus ring, we may slightly alter the visual design, but the benefits to keyboard and assistive technology users outweigh this compromise. This choice also allows us to maintain consistency with established accessibility standards.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 3px ring with 2px offset can still vanish on dark or busy backgrounds—#007AFF blends into black, and busy pages bury it. Better: a 4px ring with 4px offset in #005FCC (higher contrast) or a 2px ring with 3px offset in white (for dark mode). Settle by testing on 5 live pages: measure contrast ratio and visibility under glare.
